_README: Curated quarantine for affixes upstream stores as a FLAT CONSTANT that the wiki states are CONDITIONAL, RAMPING or TEMPORARY (#88, #214). The stored number is typically the fully-stacked maximum, so crediting it flat grants permanently what the game grants only while a trigger keeps firing. Each entry carries the verbatim wiki sentence that proves it. An affix here is DROPPED, not re-valued: the wiki states no sustained value, and inventing one would violate the never-infer rule.
_discipline: Quarantine is the conservative direction — a visible gap beats a confident wrong number. If the wiki ever states a sustained or unconditional value, the entry moves to a value correction instead and is retired from here deliberately.
_precedent: Deific Focus, ruled NOT universal on exactly this shape: 'On Spell Cast: +1 Sacred bonus to DC of that school for five seconds. Stacks up to III times.' See src/spell_focus.py's module docstring and docs/wiki-evidence/spell-focus-universal.md.
_stale_guard: Every entry records `from_value` — the flat number gear-planner carries today. The build FAILS when it no longer matches (upstream changed the encoding, so the ruling must be re-read) and FAILS when an entry reaches no record in any channel (renamed or dropped upstream).

Meridian Fragment.name: Universal Spell Power
Meridian Fragment.wiki_text: once every three seconds when you take physical damage, you get +8 Psionic Bonus to Universal Spell Power. This can stack up to three times and each stack lasts for 20 seconds.
Meridian Fragment.note: #88 - stored as the fully-stacked maximum (8 x 3 = 24) with no trigger and no duration. Credited flat it grants +24 Universal Spell Power permanently for an augment that requires being hit repeatedly. Universal Spell Power CROSS-ADDS into all ten element spellpowers (#290/#301), so the over-credit propagates to every spellpower a caster ranks. Arrived 2026-08-18 with the canon migration, whose own report recorded it as 'newly scorable' - a gain that was really an over-credit.
